ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Ready to Promote and Promote and Deploy until the pull request is approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), NOT($Setup.Story_Verification_Control__c.Disable_Story_Verification__c), OR( AND(copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c))), AND(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c))) ), NOT(Verification_No_Commits__c), NOT(copado__Pull_Requests_Approved__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Pull request approval is required before Promote.
